messages:
Avery (PR): Heads-up — embargo for Redwood Dedicated launch is Mon Apr 12 09:00 PT. Please don't share any assets externally before then. Embargo ID: RDW-DED-0426

Sam (Growth): Got it. Who's on the analyst/press briefing list? I can follow up to schedule.

Priya (Comms): Initial list: TechCrunch, The Information, VentureBeat, Bloomberg AI, and 3 analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, ISG). I'll DM full emails.

Jordan (Product): I'll draft a short quote about perf and routing guarantees. FYI the SLA excerpt we use is: "99.95% uptime for Dedicated clusters with regional failover" — open to wording edits.

Elliot (Legal): Please avoid subject-to-change claims. Replace "guarantees" with "targets" in public quote drafts. Also confirm there are no embargo exceptions for partners.

Avery (PR): Good point @Elliot. No exceptions unless signed off by Legal + Sales Ops. Priya, can you add that to the briefing notes?

Priya (Comms): Added. Also attached press kit link: https://redwood.example/press/kits/dedicated-launch (internal only until embargo). Use `DO NOT PUBLISH` watermark.

Sam (Growth): Scheduling note — prefer Tue/Wed morning PT for analyst briefings. Who can present product roadmap? @Jordan?

Jordan (Product): I can do a 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Will prepare 3 benchmark slides (latency, cost, reliability). Need numbers finalized by EOD Fri.

Elliot (Legal): Copy for embargo notice: "The information shared under embargo may not be published before Mon Apr 12 09:00 PT. Redistribution or quoting requires prior written consent." OK?

Avery (PR): That's fine. Priya, create a short email template with that line and a one-paragraph teaser.

Priya (Comms): Draft below — please confirm edits:

> Subject: Redwood Dedicated — briefing request (embargoed until Mon Apr 12 09:00 PT)
>
> Hi {name},
>
> We'd like to invite you to a briefing about Redwood Dedicated, our new reserved inference capacity offering. We'll cover performance benchmarks, SLA details, and customer migration paths. Embargo details enclosed. Can you do Tue/Wed next week?

Sam (Growth): Looks good. For analysts, we should offer a small corpus of eval prompts and the benchmark CSV. Can Eng-ML upload to sharepoint?

Jordan (Product): Will ask Eng-ML to drop `dedicated-benchmarks.csv` in the private folder by Fri 17:00 PT. Includes p95 latency, token cost, model variants.

PressBot: Reminder — embargo tag set on assets folder (RDW/press/dedicated) — automated lock until 1719363600.

Avery (PR): One more: Confirm quotes. Jordan, please post your final quote here by EOD so PR can lock it into the release.

Jordan (Product): Draft quote: "Redwood Dedicated delivers predictable performance at scale by combining GPU-optimized serving, smart routing, and workload-aware caching to reduce token cost while meeting latency targets." Open to tightening.

Elliot (Legal): Change "delivers" -> "is designed to deliver" and remove "while" clause to avoid comparative claims. Suggest:

"Redwood Dedicated is designed to deliver predictable performance at scale through GPU‑optimized serving, smart routing, and workload‑aware caching."

Avery (PR): That reads well. Priya, use Elliot's wording. All: thumbs up on the quote?

Sam (Growth): :thumbsup:

Priya (Comms): :white_check_mark: I'll slot the briefing invites for Tue/Wed PT and attach the embargo paragraph + quote. Will follow up with final attendee list.

Avery (PR): Thanks team — keep embargo compliance tight. If anyone needs partner exceptions, escalate to me + Elliot.

Jordan (Product): Uploaded benchmarks and slide deck to private folder: `presentations/dedicated-demo-v1.pptx`.

Sam (Growth): Noted. I'll coordinate invites once Priya posts times.

Elliot (Legal): All good from Legal for embargo copy and quote as edited.

Priya (Comms): Closing loop: invites sent to press + analysts, briefing slots: Tue 9:30 PT, Tue 11:00 PT, Wed 10:00 PT. Please RSVP to the calendar events.

Avery (PR): Closing — thread resolved. :partyparrot:
